paper.title_en: Holographic viscous transport in scalar-coupled Gauss-Bonnet gravity
paper.abstract_en: We test horizon formulas for the shear and bulk viscosities of a holographic plasma against viscosities extracted directly from retarded stress-tensor correlators. We work in a five-dimensional Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet model calibrated to the lattice QCD equation of state at zero baryon density. UV-finite renormalized correlators are obtained by including the required curvature and scalar counterterms, and the fluctuation equations are solved while retaining the full dependence on the Gauss-Bonnet coupling $α$, without using a horizon conservation law or an entropy-production formula. For constant coupling, the horizon conserved-current calculation reproduces the boundary Kubo results in both channels. For the scalar-dependent coupling studied here, both methods find a minimum in the shear-viscosity-to-entropy-density ratio $η/s$. In the bulk channel, the conserved-current calculation truncated at first order in $α$ yields a lower peak height in $ζ/s$, with the peak temperature nearly unchanged relative to the boundary result. For both couplings, the unmodified Eling-Oz (EO) formula, $ζ/s=(4π)^{-1}(\partialφ_h/\partial\ln s)^2$, reproduces the boundary result for $ζ/s$, where $φ_h$ is the horizon value of the scalar. The prefactor $1/(4π)$ is thus retained even when the Gauss-Bonnet interaction shifts $η/s$ from this value. These results provide a direct boundary benchmark for horizon prescriptions and support the unmodified EO formula beyond constant coupling.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在标量耦合的Gauss-Bonnet引力中检验剪切与体粘滞的全息地平线公式，并与直接由推迟应力张量关联函数提取的粘滞系数对比，属于修改引力（高阶曲率Gauss-Bonnet）与全息输运的交叉研究。工作保留对Gauss-Bonnet耦合α的完整依赖、加入引力和标量抵消项以获得紫外有限的重整化关联函数，并给出对Eling-Oz公式的边界基准检验，理论深度与方法细节较充分；但主题命中权重偏低、无引用且偏重具体模型计算，故为中等偏上评分。
decision.title_zh: 标量耦合Gauss-Bonnet引力中的全息粘滞输运
decision.abstract_zh: 我们将用于全息等离子体剪切粘滞系数和体粘滞系数的地平线公式，与直接由推迟应力张量关联函数提取的粘滞系数进行对照检验。我们工作在一个五维Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet模型中，该模型在零重子密度下被校准到格点QCD状态方程。通过引入所需的曲率抵消项和标量抵消项，得到紫外有限的重整化关联函数；在求解涨落方程时保留对Gauss-Bonnet耦合$α$的完整依赖，而不使用地平线守恒定律或熵产生公式。对于常数耦合，地平线守恒流计算在两种通道中都重现了边界的Kubo结果。对于此处研究的标量依赖耦合，两种方法都发现剪切粘滞系数与熵密度之比$η/s$存在一个极小值。在体通道中，截断到$α$一阶的守恒流计算给出$ζ/s$较低的峰值高度，而峰值温度相对于边界结果几乎不变。对于两种耦合，未经修改的Eling-Oz（EO）公式$ζ/s=(4π)^{-1}(\partialφ_h/\partial\ln s)^2$都重现了$ζ/s$的边界结果，其中$φ_h$是标量的地平线值。因此，即使Gauss-Bonnet相互作用使$η/s$偏离该数值，前因子$1/(4π)$仍然保留。这些结果为地平线规定提供了直接的边界基准，并支持未修改的EO公式在常数耦合之外仍然成立。
